## Description

Please include a summary of the change, relevant context, and which issue is addressed (if applicable).

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Performance improvement / Refactoring
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING / DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md](file:///DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md) guidelines.
- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project (`ruff check .` passes).
- [ ] I have run `python scripts/check_skill.py` and `python scripts/check_docs.py`.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] New and existing tests pass locally (`pytest`).
- [ ] I have verified that no sensitive credentials, keys, or personal paths are included.
